intro: Asterion, a night elf spirit trapped amidst the ruined pillars of Bashal'Aran, seeks the relic holding him bound to this world. Having sensed the corruption of his prison among the local grells, he directs travelers to hunt the satyrs who command them and recover the Ancient Moonstone Seal.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If the grells have come into close contact with the seal that binds my eternal prison, I suspect I know the cause. No doubt the seal has come into the possession of the satyr that lead them.

I feel strongly that this must be true, friend. One of the satyr must surely possess it. If you can obtain it, you would bring me so close to passing the bars of my prison that tears would come to my eyes.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The pillars of this shrine are as the bars of a prison to me, friend. No strength I still possess might break them, and no magic I
For a thousand years and more I have stared at them, wondering if at long last I outlived even the stone, would I be free? Or would it be invisible bars that held me then...

clips.title: Completion
paras: It... It is hard for me to even believe that what I hold now is that which has held me for so long. Let us waste no time, friend. When the seal is destroyed, I might walk the forests of the earth freely again.
